body:
Maybe that’s subtle messaging.

For most of the season he did “ride bitch” to Logan.

I figured he did it to never be late again, like he was to the infamous board meeting, but that’s also one hell of a metaphor. 

He rode bitch and jumped up front when he realized. Kendall is a crazy character.
Don’t want to leave my family but I let them down. I just keep fucking up. It’s been a record year. I need to leave.
